description: Compile without saving or deploying; returns diagnostics with file and line. Does not build the handler, so deploy can still refuse a route whose return type cannot be served.

files.description: lambda.cs first. The .cs files of the code are compiled, in any folder; nothing else is - send those, the rest may be left out.

attachment.description: Instead of code: a file the person attached to their message, by its id (read_attachment), saved as it is - a logo, a photo, a document - without its bytes passing through you.

code.description: Contents, base64 if encoding says so. Left out with attachment.

name.description: lambda.cs and every other .cs file, in any folder, are compiled; 'resources/...' is read and served ('resources/web/app.js'); anything else is code kept with the version, never compiled or served - 'docs/...' and 'tests/...' are the documentation and the tests.

name: check_code
title: Check that code compiles
